purpose: Frozen selective repair plus full numerical-contract verification; repair and compression remain separate.

quality.normalization: For each trajectory/channel S=max(max_t abs(I_reference),1e-7 mA/cm2). Charge errors divided by duration*S, not near-zero signed target charge. Report absolute errors and peak-relative charge diagnostics as well. No averaging across regimes to waive a failed critical gate.
quality.event_support: Transient timing evaluated only when reference peak-baseline contrast >=25% of S, peak >=10*floor, and peak is internal to the window. Other cases explicitly not_evaluable; amplitude/current gates still apply. Onset/offset use 10% of reference transient amplitude. Multi-event morphology needs dedicated matching in closed-loop stage.

baselines: 0.01mV voltage LUT plus canonical calcium-dependent SK
cost.timing: Same active native initial states at10ms,80resident future input ticks,no hosttransfer,alternatingorder;CUDAandwalltimes;pairedbootstrap uncertainty

hypotheses.statement: The frozen Ca_HVA-only repair transfers across full panels without the other donor-channel regressions.
hypotheses.contrast: swap100 versus swap000 versus K_full under identical primary policy
hypotheses.falsifier: New autonomous/imposed/recurrence failures remain; a local stress repair alone is insufficient.

hypotheses.statement: A coherent voltage/solve numerical policy removes autonomous failures across whole panels, not only selected cases.
hypotheses.contrast: primary versus voltage_solve64 for every frozen model, both fixed and matched references
hypotheses.falsifier: Remaining/new full-panel failures, bad canonical floors or lack of continuous-error reduction.

hypotheses.statement: Some apparent gains depend on changing the canonical numerical reference.
hypotheses.contrast: Same exact prediction versus original FP32 reference and versus policy-matched canonical reference
hypotheses.falsifier: Both references yield the same conclusions and comparable continuous errors; pass flips alone are not mechanistic proof.

hypotheses.statement: Recentered but mathematically identical FP32 solve can capture the mixed-precision benefit without its numerical cost.
hypotheses.contrast: recentered32 versus primary and voltage_solve64, full paired quality and integrated timing
hypotheses.falsifier: Autonomous failures persist or new ones appear; no deployment claim from faster inaccurate results.

outcomes.primary_repair: All newly evaluated primary panels plus reused imposed stress/recurrence pass; still requires independent confirmation and deployment-cost assessment.
outcomes.numerical_repair: Improvement only under diagnostic numerics is evidence for a concrete contract change, not a waiver of primaryFP32 or Task42.
outcomes.insufficient: If no full-panel repair and no new actionable causal distinction, stop this repair family; no automatic training extension.

stop_rules: 60-minute scientific-worker wall budget, excluding environment setup; preserve partials; exhaustion is not scientific NO-GO.
Nonfinite parameters/traces, SHA mismatch, primary H control mismatch: stop and preserve technical failure.
No automatic retraining, reselection, new capacity, threshold changes, independent-confirmation claim or Task42.
